research_question: Does the frozen v8 rotation-only camera transfer realize standard-BA pose gains on Garden for two preregistered perturbation seeds at the common 7000-step endpoint?
claim_boundary: Garden is a historical development scene selected before v7 rendering results. V9 is a cross-scene confirmation outside the Bonsai/Room mechanism-design scenes, not a never-used external test set and not final_v1.

method_frozen_from_v8.A: Construct the normal post-BA VGGT Gaussian initialization, apply the registered 1-degree zero-translation perturbation in the normalized trainer frame, and keep those training cameras fixed for all 7000 steps.
method_frozen_from_v8.C: Use the identical normal post-BA VGGT Gaussian initialization; set each OpenCV c2w rotation to the train-only standard-BA output and retain that camera's A world-space center exactly; keep cameras fixed for all 7000 steps.
method_frozen_from_v8.comparison: A versus C; the obsolete v7 A-versus-B Garden draft is not executed.
method_frozen_from_v8.standard_ba_credit: All step-0 pose recovery belongs to established standard BA. V9 tests only cross-scene/cross-perturbation downstream realization of the frozen v8 transfer.

scene_and_seeds.selection_provenance: Sole existing Mip-NeRF 360 development-v24 scene not used in v3-v6 design; frozen in v7 before its rendering results.

legal_asset_generation.input: Exactly the 24 manifest training RGB files; no held-out image, reference pose, historical 3D coordinate, or final_v1 asset.
legal_asset_generation.preprocessing: Normal project staging copies byte-identical selected training files into a flat images directory and writes a train_only staging receipt. The pinned demo's load_and_preprocess_images_square uses size 1024 and the paired adapter maps coordinates back to original image pixels.
legal_asset_generation.fixed_pipeline: bgs.vggt_ba_pair patches the single official pycolmap.bundle_adjustment call, snapshots the one pre-BA tracked reconstruction, makes distinct pre/post objects, runs official BA only on post, and emits immutable pre_ba/post_ba plus hashes.

standard_ba.implementation: The executed v6 CPU COLMAP 3.13/Ceres standard-BA implementation, adapted only for Garden and perturbation seed identity.
standard_ba.input_cameras: A perturbed OpenCV c2w in the normalized trainer frame
standard_ba.input_tracks: Complete train-only pre_ba track identities; split by whole track before triangulation
standard_ba.gauge: camera 0 full pose plus one camera 1 translation component, matching v6
standard_ba.accepted_track_observations: All observations belonging to each accepted/triangulated fit track enter Cauchy BA; the triangulation RANSAC mask is recorded but is not a BA-observation filter.

coordinate_projection_admission.original_points_only: Use the common post_ba initialization points and their legally traced 2D track mapping; do not substitute re-triangulated BA points.
coordinate_projection_admission.normalization: Apply the exact pinned gsplat Parser transform jointly to original points and source cameras before any normalized-frame projection.
required_contracts: complete ordered train camera identity and c2w/w2c roundtrip
A is byte-compatible with bgs.geometry perturbation for the registered seed
C rotation equals standard-BA rotation exactly
C world center equals A world center exactly
fixed common-observation residuals are finite and full/valid failure denominators are reported
no raw point is projected with a normalized camera

same_between_arms: post_ba Gaussian initialization files and initial tensor hashes
optimizers, learning-rate clocks and structural strategy

acceptance.confirmation_pass: Both seeds pass every pose, rendering, technical and denominator gate at step 7000.

budget.admission: BLOCKED: complete upper bound does not fit the actual campaign balance; do not reserve or submit any GPU task.

stopping_rule: With the current budget or legal pair absent, produce a BLOCKED pre-submission report only. Do not run a partial seed/arm, reduce resolution/views/steps, inspect Garden held-out quality, or start asset inference. A future explicit budget increase must first rerun the identity, asset, projection and budget gates without changing this science protocol.
v8_append_only_review_notes: Bonsai C-minus-B SSIM is -0.0012243172606907216; v8 did not improve all three C-versus-B rendering metrics.

For LPIPS deltas, lower is better. V8's generic ascending sorter stored the best five LPIPS changes under worst_five and the worst five under best_five; numerical values are retained and labels must be interpreted in reverse for LPIPS only.
